data_gaps.reason: The supplied pages state 'any consecutive 30 trading days' for the conditional put trigger, but do not state a separate observation window for put.
The supplied pages state 'any consecutive 30 trading days' for the conditional put trigger, but do not state a separate required_days value for put.
The supplied pages state the put right may be exercised once per interest year, but do not state a separate annual exercise limit.
The supplied pages state the put price includes accrued interest and refer to the redemption clause for calculation, but do not state a separate accrued interest rule for put.
The supplied pages state that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain from voting, but do not state whether bondholders must abstain.
The supplied pages state the conversion period begins six months after the issuance completion date, but the issuance completion date itself is not stated on these pages.
The supplied pages state the conversion period ends on the bond maturity date, but the maturity date is not stated on these pages.
The supplied pages do not state the issue date; only the record date 2020-10-14 (T-1 day) is mentioned.
The supplied pages state a 6-year term from the issue date, but the issue date is not stated, so the maturity date cannot be determined.
The supplied pages state the maximum fundraising amount of RMB 1,600,000万元, but do not state the final issue principal.
The supplied pages state a face value of 100 yuan per bond and 1,000 yuan per lot (10 bonds), but do not state the denomination as a single scalar.
The supplied pages describe interest payment date deferral for holidays, but do not provide a general holiday deferral rule for all payments.
The supplied pages state 'any consecutive 30 trading days' for the conditional redemption trigger, but do not state a separate observation window for redemption.
The supplied pages state 'at least 15 trading days' within 30 trading days for the conditional redemption trigger, but do not state a separate required_days value for redemption.
The supplied pages provide a formula for accrued interest, but do not state a separate accrued interest redemption rule.

The supplied pages state the put price includes accrued interest and refer to the redemption clause for calculation, but do not state a separate accrued interest rule for put.
The supplied pages describe treatment of adjustment days for the downward revision trigger, but do not state a separate adjustment_day_treatment value.
The supplied pages state that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain from voting, but do not state whether bondholders must abstain.
